nodes.summary: For every finite non-abelian simple group $S$ there is a finite group $G$ such that $S$ is a composition factor of $G$ and every maximal subgroup $M$ of $G$ with $\pi(M) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of primes dividing the order of $X$.
nodes.title: Moretó: every non-abelian simple group occurs in Kourovka 19.55(a)

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every finite non-abelian simple group $S$ there is a finite group $G$ such that $S$ is a composition factor of $G$ and every maximal subgroup $M$ of $G$ with $\pi(M) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of primes dividing the order of $X$.
nodes.title: Kourovka 19.55(a) (Monakhov): every non-abelian simple group occurs

nodes.summary: For every natural number $h$ there is a finite soluble group $G$ whose Fitting height is greater than $h$ and in which every maximal subgroup $M$ with $\pi(M) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of primes dividing the order of $X$.
nodes.title: Moretó: soluble groups in Kourovka 19.55 have unbounded Fitting height

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every natural number $h$ there is a finite soluble group $G$ whose Fitting height is greater than $h$ and in which every maximal subgroup $M$ with $\pi(M) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of primes dividing the order of $X$.
nodes.title: Kourovka 19.55(b) (Monakhov): unbounded Fitting height

nodes.summary: A group $G$ has a chief factor of rank greater than a natural number $r$ when there are a chief factor $A / B$ of $G$, a prime $p$ and a natural number $k > r$ such that the index $[A : B]$ equals $p^k$.
nodes.title: Chief factor of rank above a bound

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is supersoluble when there are a natural number $n$ and elements $g_0, \dots, g_{n-1}$ of $G$ that generate $G$ such that, for every $i \le n$, the subgroup $G_i = \langle g_j : j < i \rangle$ is normal in $G$.
nodes.title: Supersoluble group (generator form)

nodes.summary: A group $G$ satisfies Monakhov's condition when every maximal subgroup $M$ of $G$ with $\pi(M) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of prime factors of the order of $X$ if $X$ is finite, and is empty if $X$ is infinite.
nodes.title: Monakhov's condition

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite soluble group in which every maximal subgroup $H$ with $\pi(H) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of primes dividing the order of $X$. Then for every prime $p$ the group $G$ has $p$-length at most $1$: there are normal subgroups $N \le M$ of $G$ such that $p$ does not divide $|N|$, the index $[M : N]$ is a power of $p$, and $p$ does not divide $[G : M]$.
nodes.title: Moretó: soluble groups in Kourovka 19.55 have p-length at most one

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every finite soluble group $G$ in which every maximal subgroup $H$ with $\pi(H) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of primes dividing the order of $X$, and for every prime $p$, the group $G$ has $p$-length at most $1$: there are normal subgroups $N \le M$ of $G$ such that $p$ does not divide $|N|$, the index $[M : N]$ is a power of $p$, and $p$ does not divide $[G : M]$.
nodes.title: Kourovka 19.55(b) (Monakhov): p-length at most one

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, a group $G$ has $p$-length at most $1$ when there are normal subgroups $N \le M$ of $G$ such that $N$ is finite of order not divisible by $p$, the index $[M : N]$ equals $p^k$ for some natural number $k$ (an infinite index counting as $0$), and the index $[G : M]$ is finite and not divisible by $p$.
nodes.title: Groups of p-length at most one

nodes.summary: For every natural number $r$ there is a finite soluble group $G$ such that every maximal subgroup $M$ of $G$ with $\pi(M) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of prime divisors of $|X|$, and $G$ has a chief factor $A/B$ (normal subgroups $B < A$ of $G$ with no normal subgroup of $G$ strictly between them) of order $p^k$ for some prime $p$ and some $k > r$.
nodes.title: Unbounded chief-factor rank under Monakhov's condition

nodes.summary: The statement that for every natural number $r$ there is a finite soluble group $G$ satisfying Monakhov's condition (every maximal subgroup $M$ of $G$ with $\pi(M) = \pi(G)$ is supersoluble, where $\pi(X)$ is the set of prime divisors of $|X|$) that has a chief factor $A/B$ of order $p^k$ for some prime $p$ and some $k > r$. This is the answer to Kourovka 19.55(b) for the rank.
nodes.title: Unbounded chief-factor rank under Monakhov's condition (the claim)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
